Independent IDOE PDF not located this session. MAINTAINER ATTESTATION (Damian Betebenner, 2026-09-02): SGPstateData is AUTHORITATIVE for these cut scores. Its Indiana values were derived from IDOE documents and used operationally in production SGP analyses; much of that source documentation is no longer retrievable on the public web. A missing URL is therefore a documentation gap, not a provenance defect. See wiki/sources/sgpstatedata-operational-provenance.md.
